intent: Daily demand wave for esteban-media: pick and ship ONE bounded demand move from fresh evidence per the standing charter

visual_evidence.scope_reason: Bilingual explanatory content below an existing calculator; no new scene, motion system, route or layout redesign.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Información adicional detrás de «Más», un acordeón o una hoja. La explicación no bloquea la experiencia ni aparece obligatoriamente.
visual_evidence.comparison: Existing calculator pages have no FAQ answers in their initial HTML. Candidate appends closed native disclosures with the existing Esteban skin; screenshots show the affected section at phone and desktop sizes. Builder inspection is not independent craft approval.

brief.visitor: A creator checking whether a spoken script fits a video.
brief.promise: Explain the existing estimator and help the visitor check it aloud.
brief.primary_action: Paste spoken words, pick a pace and compare a timed reading.
brief.friction: The page promises exact timing although it only divides word count by selected pace.

kpi.outcome: Useful organic visits that can lead to a scoped editing inquiry.
kpi.event: Existing delegated cta_click for the service link; no new lead event.
kpi.denominator: Same page-level Search Console impressions; not aggregate property impressions.
kpi.baseline: Spanish calculator: 21 impressions, 0 clicks, position 7.380952 for 2026-09-07 through 2026-10-04.
kpi.evidence: gsc-page.json is an authenticated final-data read this session.
kpi.readout: cto-seo-lead: compare T+14 and T+28 after actual deployment.
kpi.decision_rule: Low samples remain inconclusive; repair inaccurate guidance immediately; do not claim rank causation.

concept.idea: Calculator first, optional guidance after it.
concept.brand_reason: Reuse the current cream/terracotta surface and native RailFaq with existing typography.
concept.interaction: Open a question with touch or keyboard.
concept.visible_response: The answer appears directly under that question.
concept.direct_path: Calculator remains usable without opening an answer.
concept.alternatives: Rejected adding a new guide URL because the current tool has demand and lacks its own explanation.

story.opening: Estimate the length of your spoken script.
story.action: Paste the words and select a pace.
story.consequence: See an estimate, then learn its limits if needed.
story.next_step: Read aloud or explore the matching Reels editing page.

content.visible: One short instruction, updated date and three question labels.
content.optional_html: Three native details answers present in raw served HTML.
content.linked_depth: Existing EN/ES Reels editing pages, no additional guide.

references.borrow: Pinned RailFaq disclosure behavior and current Esteban type/color tokens.
references.avoid: Do not add a wall of text, decorative artwork or a new visual world for a calculation explanation.

components.local_reason: The brand wrapper and bilingual formula explanation apply only to this calculator.

verification.rendered_states: 375x667, 390x844 and 1440x900, EN/ES, FAQ closed/open and service link.
verification.motion: No new motion; exercise reduced motion and native details behavior.
verification.accessibility_performance: Keyboard/touch opening, no horizontal overflow, 16px answer text; build and existing shared component checks.
verification.raw_html: FAQ answers must equal schema and remain present with scripts disabled.
verification.conversion_boundary: Verify real service destinations; no form sends or claimed leads for this content change.

reviewers.craft: Independent Antigravity review requested from top-level coordinator; local screenshots are builder evidence only.
reviewers.behavior: Codex checks plus cto-qa-lead final verification.
